text:
alex_sales: Hey team — prepping a POC for NovaGov. They want SSO + SCIM + RBAC details and pricing impact. Quick sync?

jess_eng: Buyer asks: 1) SAML SSO (IdP & SP initiated), audience check, 2) SCIM provisioning for ~200k users (bulk/delta), 3) RBAC mapping from SCIM groups, 4) domain verification for tenant lock, 5) pricing: Dedicated vs Hosted for sustained 400 rps, 6) audit log retention SLA.

amend: They'll use Ping now, may move to Okta later.

mira_sec: Security notes — we support SAML2.0 signed assertions (RSA-SHA256), ACS URL validation, assertion signature and integrity checks. For hosted tenants we require DNS TXT domain proof; Dedicated supports customer-managed certs and KMS.

carlo_se: SCIM details — RFC7644 compliant. We support bulk PATCH with 1k user batches and incremental deltas. Recommend our SCIM helper tool for initial import and exponential backoff for retries. Example endpoint: PATCH /scim/v2/Users (payloads/logging handled by helper).

jess_eng: RBAC — group-to-role mapping: map SCIM groups to Redwood roles (admin, dev, readonly). Group sync runs every 5m by default; can be tuned. Role changes create soft state for 24h before token revocation to prevent mass lockouts.

alex_sales: Pricing question — what if they want SCIM sync every 1m and 5x longer audit retention?

sam_billing: Pricing callouts: Hosted is usage-based and cheaper at low/variable qps. Dedicated recommended for sustained 400 rps: base Dedicated fee + usage; SCIM-heavy syncs and extended retention incur infra surcharges. Need token/use profile to give a precise quote.

mira_sec: Note for legal — Hosted provides tenant isolation logically; physical isolation and dedicated KMS/HSM only on Dedicated + enterprise add-ons (SOC2, contract terms). Also we can push audit logs to customer S3 for Dedicated.

carlo_se: POC runbook suggestion: 1) configure test SAML connector (we consume Ping metadata), 2) run SCIM bulk import to staging via helper, 3) apply role mapping and validate RBAC, 4) run 24h load test at 400 rps. I can run import + load with infra.

alex_sales: Action items: @carlo_se run SCIM + load; @jess_eng confirm SAML assertion timeouts + audience rules; @mira_sec prepare security summary for questionnaire; @sam_billing provide preliminary Dedicated/Hosted numbers.

jess_eng: SAML specifics: we validate Conditions NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter with a 120s clock skew, audience must match SP EntityID or ACS, we support encrypted assertions on request.

mira_sec: Short security summary: signed assertions (RSA-SHA256), ACS/EntityID validation, optional encrypted assertions, SCIM over HTTPS (mTLS available for Dedicated), audit logs retention configurable up to 365 days, Dedicated can ship logs to customer S3.

sam_billing: I'll post a preliminary quote EOD — need avg tokens/request and whether they want reserved capacity. Alex, can you confirm token estimate?

alex_sales: Asking customer now, will update here. :thumbsup: 

carlo_se: One more operational note: default SCIM throttle on Hosted is 100 req/min per tenant. If they want 1m delta syncs we'll advise rate-limiter config and backoff.

amend: cc @deploy-bot for staging tenant.

deploy-bot: [info] created staging tenant novagov-poc in us-west-2, scim-endpoint=https://poc.redwood.ai/scim/novagov, service-account=********.

alex_sales: Thanks all. Next: carlo runs import Tue AM, jess confirms SAML edge-cases Wed, mira drafts questionnaire Thu, sam posts quote Thu EOD, then legal loop.

carlo_se: Ack — will log results to the runbook and attach SCIM error samples.

mira_sec: Will attach one-pager on domain verification options (DNS TXT vs cert pinning) with questionnaire answers.

sam_billing: Note — to finalize quote I need tokens/request; alex pls push.

alex_sales: Will do. Thanks team.
